optimizer.lifetimeGisTitle: Cumulative Guaranteed Income Supplement received over the plan — RRSP/RRIF withdrawals and pensions claw it back 50¢/$, TFSA does not.
optimizer.foot: Each row replays the full projection with one change and binary-searches the highest flat yearly spending that survives to max age — deterministic, no randomness. "Apply" writes that lever into your inputs (unsaved until you click Save).
optimizer.infeasible: No spending level reaches {{pct}}% success — the plan depletes even at $0 spending (fixed costs are too high). Lower your expenses or add income first.
optimizer.unconstrained: Even very high spending clears {{pct}}% success — the plan is not spending-constrained. You can spend freely within the tested range.
optimizer.over: ({{amount}} over — you're above the sustainable level)
optimizer.writesDesired: writes to Desired Spending (unsaved until you Save)
optimizer.approx: Approximate: the answer is exact for the 500 futures tested, but a fresh batch of futures lands within a point or two. Higher targets → lower sustainable spending.
optimizer.lead: Invert the verdict: pick a confidence level and the solver finds the most you can spend per year while your Monte Carlo still succeeds that often. It binary-searches spending against 500 randomized market futures ({{vol}}% volatility), then you can apply the result to your plan.

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.howTo: Open Google AI Studio, sign in with a Google account, click "Get API key" → "Create API key", and paste it here.
gemini.cost: Free tier available with daily limits — the cheapest way to try cloud AI.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.howTo: Create an OpenRouter account, go to Keys → "Create key", and paste it here. One key reaches the free pool (openrouter/free and ids ending in :free) plus paid models.
openrouter.cost: Free models: no token charge (rate-limited). Paid models are pay-as-you-go.

anthropic.name: Anthropic (Claude)
anthropic.howTo: Sign in to the Anthropic Console, go to Settings → API Keys → "Create key", and paste it here.
anthropic.cost: Pay-as-you-go; you add a small credit balance first.

openai.name: OpenAI (ChatGPT models)
openai.howTo: Sign in to the OpenAI platform, go to API keys → "Create new secret key", and paste it here.
openai.cost: Pay-as-you-go; separate from a ChatGPT subscription.

ollama.name: Ollama (your own server)
ollama.howTo: Install Ollama on your computer, run "ollama pull <model>" then "ollama serve". No key — just the local address (default http://localhost:11434/v1).

openai-compatible.name: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
openai-compatible.howTo: For any service that speaks the OpenAI API (LM Studio, Together, Groq, a company proxy…). Paste its base URL and key.

schedule.footAmounts: Amounts are in nominal (future) dollars of each year: the spending target and contributions grow with inflation, while balances, gains and benefits are the actual dollars that year. colTitles.spendingTarget: After-tax income goal for the year (desired spending inflated to that year)
colTitles.incomeTax: Incremental tax on this year's withdrawals (registered draws + realized gains) beyond the tax on benefits alone, plus OAS clawback. Reads $0 late in life once the portfolio is drained — that does NOT mean tax stopped; see Total Tax.
colTitles.totalTax: Total tax on ALL of the year's income (CPP, OAS, pension, employment, withdrawals) plus OAS clawback. Charged every year taxable income is received, right to the final year.
colTitles.cumulativeTax: Running total of income tax paid since retirement
colTitles.gis: Guaranteed Income Supplement (tax-free; couples assessed on combined income)
colTitles.rdsp: Registered Disability Savings Plan. Growth is tax-sheltered; on withdrawal the grant/bond/growth portion is taxable (only contribution principal is tax-free).
colTitles.fhsa: First Home Savings Account. Contributions are deductible; growth is tax-sheltered. Transfers to the RRSP at retirement (never drawn directly).
colTitles.home: Home value minus reverse-mortgage loan balance. The loan compounds with interest and draws, eroding equity over time.
colTitles.debts: Total outstanding debt balance (mortgage, credit cards, loans, lines of credit). Interest accrues each year; payments are funded from spending.

backtestUi.endingByStart: Ending balance by window start year
backtestUi.truncated: Your plan's horizon is longer than the {{years}}-year historical record, so each window was capped at {{window}} years — the backtest doesn't reach your full horizon. A very early retirement age is the usual cause.
backtestUi.foot: Each bar replays the plan against one {{years}}-year historical sequence of real (after-inflation) returns, with spending held in today's dollars. Bars sit at each window's start year; the last window ends in {{end}}, so all {{record}} years of data are used. Rose bars ran out of money before max age. 60% S&P/TSX total return + 40% GoC long bond, deflated by CPI.

donate.p1: RE: tired is a free, open-source side project that runs entirely in your browser, sans servers, accounts, or data harvesting. Your privacy — and mine! — are maximally important.
donate.p2: It’s also mostly built with the help of an AI pair-programmer, which costs a few bucks. But really, I just want all Canadians to think about their money and do something about it!
donate.p3: Anything left over from donations, after I pay for tokens et al., goes into the accounts this app was built to help optimize.
donate.p4: So if RE: tired saves you some money, or helps you get a clearer picture of where you’re headed and what you might need to do to get there, I’m blessed to receive a few bucks to that end.
donate.p5: Maybe you’ll help me retire a few days early. :)

yearDetail.rrifMinHint: Mandatory RRIF minimum, forced out first. Taxed as income.
yearDetail.rrifDrawHint: Discretionary RRIF withdrawal. Taxed as income; grossed up so after-tax covers the need.
yearDetail.rrspDrawHint: RRSP withdrawal (before RRIF conversion). Taxed as income; grossed up.
yearDetail.taxableHint: Non-registered. Only the embedded-gain fraction is taxed.
yearDetail.taxableGainHint: The embedded-gain part of this draw, taxed at the inclusion rate. The rest is return of capital (tax-free).
yearDetail.cashHint: After-tax cash reserve, used as a last resort.
yearDetail.rdspHint: Disability-plan withdrawal. The grant/bond/growth portion is taxable; the contribution principal is a tax-free return of capital.
yearDetail.rdspTaxableHint: The grant/bond/growth part of this draw, added to taxable income. The rest is tax-free contribution principal.
yearDetail.rmDrawHint: Tax-free borrowing against home equity; the loan grows by this amount.
yearDetail.registeredNote: Registered draws are grossed up for tax.
yearDetail.rdspContribHint: Not deductible (like a TFSA); attracts grants/bonds at lower incomes.
yearDetail.fhsaContribHint: Deductible (like an RRSP); capped by the annual and lifetime limits.
yearDetail.cashGrowthHint: Cash earns the lower cushion rate.
yearDetail.rdspGrowthHint: Tax-sheltered growth; taxable only when withdrawn.
yearDetail.fhsaGrowthHint: Tax-sheltered growth; transfers to the RRSP at retirement (tax-free there too).
yearDetail.cdsgHint: Canada Disability Savings Grant — matches contributions up to 300%/200% at lower incomes.
yearDetail.cdsbHint: Canada Disability Savings Bond — income-tested; no contribution needed.
yearDetail.fhsaDeductibleHint: Reduces this year's taxable income like an RRSP contribution.
yearDetail.tfsaRoomHint: Remaining TFSA contribution room at year end (after this year's accrual and deposits).
yearDetail.rrspRoomHint: Remaining RRSP contribution room at year end (after this year's accrual and deposits).
yearDetail.tfsaOverHint: This much would have gone into the TFSA but ran out of room, so it was redirected to the taxable account.
yearDetail.rrspOverHint: This much would have gone into the RRSP but ran out of room, so it was redirected to the taxable account.
yearDetail.grossPayHint: Earned income — stacks on benefits for tax, OAS clawback and GIS.
yearDetail.taxOnItHint: The marginal tax on this pay, on top of the tax on benefits alone.
yearDetail.afterTaxHint: Saved into the job's account, or used to top up spending first.
yearDetail.incomeTaxHint: Tax on registered draws and realized gains beyond the tax on benefits alone, plus OAS clawback.
yearDetail.totalTaxHint: Tax on the year's ENTIRE income (benefits + employment + withdrawals + gains) plus OAS clawback — what a tax return would show. Charged every year taxable income is received.
yearDetail.oasClawbackHint: OAS recovery tax: net income above the threshold is clawed back at 15¢/$.
yearDetail.interestAccruedHint: Compounds onto the loan even after the LTV ceiling stops new draws.
yearDetail.scheduledDrawHint: Planned draw, CPI-indexed, capped by LTV headroom.
yearDetail.topUpDrawHint: Last-resort borrowing to cover the year's shortfall.
yearDetail.debtInterestHint: This year's interest charge, compounded onto the balance before the payment.
yearDetail.paymentHint: Serviced out of cash flow (funded from your accounts like any other expense).
yearDetail.rdspBasisTitle: Contribution basis {{amount}} (tax-free); the rest is taxable on withdrawal
yearDetail.fhsaBalanceTitle: Contributed to date {{amount}}; transfers to the RRSP at retirement

assistant.title: AI Assistant

assistant.onDeviceTitle: Runs entirely on this device: no account, no key, nothing you type leaves the computer.
assistant.cloudTitle: Chats go directly from this browser to the provider; the key is stored only in this browser.
assistant.answersOnlyTitle: Tools are off for this model (catalog default, or a Settings → Assistant override). It answers from a summary of your plan. Force tools on under Settings → Assistant to test.
assistant.collapseList: Collapse the chat list to the left
assistant.noChats: No chats yet. Start a new one.
assistant.emptyLead: Each chat is saved on this device so you can come back to it.

assistant.placeholderAsk: Ask about your plan, or describe your situation…
assistant.stuck: This reply stopped while it was waiting for you. Use the regenerate button to run it again.
assistant.truncatedRetry: This answer was cut short (token limit). Regenerate to retry it.
assistant.truncatedNone: This answer was cut short (token limit). It spent the whole budget thinking and produced no answer — regenerate to retry.
assistant.toolDetails: Click to see the call details

assistant.customPlaceholder: e.g. "Keep answers short" or "Focus on the TFSA vs RRSP trade-off".
assistant.basePromptTitle: View and edit the assistant's base persona prompt (applies to every chat)
assistant.useDefaultTitle: Stop customizing and use the built-in default
assistant.ctxHard: Estimated context usage: ~{{used}} of {{limit}} tokens (~4 chars/token). Over the model's context window — raise "Context window" for this connection on the Connections page, or older messages will be summarized aggressively.
assistant.ctxCompacted: Estimated context usage: ~{{used}} of {{limit}} tokens (~4 chars/token). Older messages have been compacted into a summary to fit.
assistant.ctxOk: Estimated context usage: ~{{used}} of {{limit}} tokens (~4 chars/token). Past {{pct}}% the oldest messages are summarized to fit.
assistant.generate: Generate a response to this message
assistant.pickerTitle: Pick which model answers. On-computer models download on first use; more models live on the Models page.
assistant.offlineCompact: Load a local or free model to chat here — or copy a prompt into another AI.
assistant.offlineLead: Copy a self-contained prompt into any AI (ChatGPT, Claude, …) below — or connect a model (even one that runs privately on this device) to chat right here.
assistant.customQPlaceholder: Type a custom question; it replaces the preset.
assistant.askLead: Embeds your plan and the computed results, so the AI answers from the real numbers. Once you paste, that AI provider reads your plan under its own privacy policy.
assistant.tuneLead: A self-contained prompt describing your plan, the levers, and the exact JSON format to reply with. Paste it into any AI. Heads up: once you paste, that provider reads your full plan under its own privacy policy.
assistant.pasteLead: Paste the model's JSON below. It's validated field-by-field — unknown fields ignored, out-of-range values rejected with reasons — then applied to your inputs.
